# GPU Atlas project instructions

- Before proposing or implementing project changes, read
  [REQUIREMENTS.md](../REQUIREMENTS.md).
- Treat confirmed requirements, implementation choices, and open decisions as
  distinct. Do not promote assistant suggestions into user-approved requirements.
- Follow the user's latest explicit direction and update the requirements record
  when a decision changes. Ask when a material behavioral choice is ambiguous.
- Wording requests must not silently change forecasting math, defaults, or scope.
- Use plain language. Avoid "copies" for serving capacity and unexplained jargon.
- Preserve unrelated work. Keep UI text and directly related documentation aligned
  with the implemented behavior.
